checksums.name: sum32_le_struct
checksums.formula_detail: u32 sum (mod 2^32) of 267 little-endian u32 words at struct offsets 0x000..0x428 inclusive, i.e. bytes [0,0x42C); stored dword excluded. FUN_08012fc4: acc+=*(u32*)(base+off), off+=4 while off<=bound (bound inferred 0x428).

io_driver_functions.notes: Flash autoselect identify: 0xAA/0x55/0x90 unlock, read ID at 0x0E000000 + second addr, 0xAA/0x55/0xF0 reset; returns (id1&0xFF)<<8|(id2&0xFF). Literal pool addrs unresolved except 0x0E000000.
Flash init/select: WAITCNT |=3, identify, walk vendor table (entry check at +0x28, 0 terminator), copy 5 dwords+ptr to flash-param globals 0x08099060..; boot caller FUN_080003ec line 195.
Flash config selector: if param<=3 stores byte, indexes table byte*4, writes *param2; called from boot with (1, DAT) when identify==0 (line 197). Exact semantics unresolved.
Relocates flash wait/poll code template from ROM (addr^1 thumb) into RAM/stack buffer; required while Flash array unreadable during program/erase.

ReadFlash(sector,offset,dest,size): WAITCNT|=3, relocate template, core 0x08099b48(0x0E000000+offset+(sector<<sector_shift),dest,size,stack). Callgraph lists no callers because calls use func_ prefix in decompiled.c.
Program+verify retry x3: verify via 0x08099b44(sector,src,*DAT), if 0 program via 0x080993cc, break on success.
EraseFlashSector(sector<16): unlock AA/55, cmd 0x80, AA/55, 0x30 at sector addr 0x0E000000+(sector<<shift), wait via relocated code core(2,addr,0xFF). No caller in corpus (jumptable/unrecovered).
Single-byte program: unlock AA/55/0xA0, *dest=*src byte, core(1,dest,byte). No caller in corpus.
sum32 over struct dwords (see checksums). Callgraph empty due to func_ prefix; textual calls at lines 1597,1612,1699.
Load/validate/select sector, read 0x430B into live struct.
Save: dedup-compare, next-sector, magic+checksum stamp, erase/program via 0x08099484. No caller in 81-function corpus.
Default/factory struct init on load failure (see fields). Called via func_ at line 1800, so callgraph callees empty.
